Registered Nurse — Acute Medical Unit
St. Margaret's Community Hospital
Galway, Ireland — 39 hrs/week, rotating shifts

We are recruiting Registered Nurses to join the Acute Medical Unit at St. Margaret's. The unit cares for adults presenting with acute medical conditions — sepsis, COPD exacerbations, cardiac events, decompensated diabetes — and supports an average length of stay of 4 days.

The role
Reporting to the Clinical Nurse Manager, you will deliver direct patient care during 12-hour shifts on a 3-on/4-off rota. You will be one of six nurses on the floor at any time and will be paired with a healthcare assistant for each shift.

Responsibilities
• Monitor patients' vital signs and recognise early signs of deterioration
• Administer prescribed medication, including IV antibiotics, anticoagulants and analgesics
• Document all care in the electronic health record before end-of-shift handover
• Perform wound assessment and dressing changes for surgical and pressure-related wounds
• Triage admissions arriving from the Emergency Department
• Communicate with the multidisciplinary team — consultants, physiotherapists, social workers — on care plans
• Maintain strict infection prevention and control standards on the ward

Essential
• Registration with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland (NMBI)
• At least 1 year of post-registration experience in an acute setting
• Current BLS certification
• Evidence of recent CPD activity

Desirable
• Mentorship of student nurses or new graduates
• Experience with the EpicCare electronic health record

We expect candidates to demonstrate empathy with vulnerable adults, calm decision-making under pressure, and the ability to communicate clearly with patients and families at distressing moments.
